_note: Measured with the CORRECTED counter (tools/rng-audit.mjs), which strips comments before counting. The previous numbers were prose plus code — every comment that discussed rng() was counted as a draw — so they are not comparable to these and the audit had been failing for months on drift that did not exist. Two of these figures are genuine increases the old baseline never recorded (market.ts rrange 37->38, dev.ts rng 29->31) and they belong to the planning-board and cornice commits, which document their draws. Re-stated here so the NEXT comparison is the first one that means anything. Bump only with a measured re-roll note. dev.ts rng 31->32 (2026-09-28): the backdate draw in seedOpeningPipeline, added by 11c7580 ('The cranes were already up'), whose commit message documents the re-roll and regenerated BASELINE.json but did not bump this file; the audit had been red on the default branch since. sim.ts rng 4->8, rrange 9->12 (2026-10-09): the ripe-land listing draws (listLand: ask, listing life, the ripe check, the ripe list roll, the count and the pick) added by 99f0b0a (MDGA), all on their own "land" channel so no other stream re-rolls; that commit regenerated BASELINE.json (BASELINE_ATTRIBUTION 'MDGA') but did not bump this file, and the audit had been red on the default branch since. Bumped in the street-plan-4 PR, which adds no draws of its own. Each of those commits regenerated or reported BASELINE.json; none bumped this file.
